questcoplanar: TV and world on one plane
remote_hint: Choose with a ray or fingertip. One grip moves objects; both resize. The large virtual controller includes all SNES buttons.
remote_hand_hint: Pinch and drag the stick; use the other hand for buttons. Middle-finger pinch grabs handles. Tracking lost: controls release.
questworldbackdrop: Wrap the game's backdrop around the VR room
questresizehint: Hold both grips and spread your hands to resize, even while placement is locked. Regrip to keep scaling, or move the right stick up/down while gripping. Y opens options; R3 brings the menu back nearby.
questpinballnote: The arcade table shows the loaded area. Original cartridge physics and object activation remain unchanged.
questsurround: Expand the level around the CRT
queststereonote: 3D furniture uses stereo rendering; options stay on a separate sharp panel. AR shows your room instead of the studio. The preview pattern contains no game assets.
questpauselost: Pause when wall tracking is lost
questcompanion: Keep a companion menu near me
questplacewall: Place virtual wall in front of me
questfindwall: Auto place on a scanned wall
questcalibratefloor: Use left controller height as floor
questrefreshunknown: Runtime refresh information is not available yet.
questrefreshdenied: The runtime declined the refresh request; its system preference remains active.
questwalltrackinglost: Wall tracking lost. The wall is hidden; restore or place it again from this menu.
questwalllockednotice: Wall stays fixed. Y opens options; right-stick click recenters their companion panel.
questfloorestimated: Floor: standing-height estimate. Calibrate if needed.
questwallnote: Fixed stage framing overrides normal camera choices until Spatial screen is restored. Without a usable room model, place a virtual wall manually. A mural can extend beyond the real wall.

questguidehint: Point at or focus a setting for its illustrated explanation. X opens this guide; B or Y closes it first.
questintro: Whole-level walls, floor views, arcade tables, CRTs and curved galleries. Experimental XR preview; use both grips to resize.
questarunavailable: Passthrough is unavailable in this session. VR remains available.
questgrab: Hold both grip buttons to move and scale a room-pinned screen. Release to pin it. Point the right controller at the menu and squeeze its trigger to click; the right stick scrolls.
questqualitynote: Lightweight reduces battery and rendering load. A larger virtual canvas costs more GPU work. Pixel 1:1 refers to game pixels in this canvas; headset optics and the compositor resample the final image. For a Bluetooth gamepad, switch Touch controls off.

Previews use verified placements and loc: Previews use verified placements and locally observed sprites. Unknown appearances use a labelled outline; original activation rules are unchanged.
Rewind follows the original game speed. History duration depends on the cartridge and selected memory budget.
XR preview: physical headset testing is: XR preview: physical headset testing is deferred. These preferences also prepare the Android edition.
Picture help detail: Choose the view coverage, then pixel scale and filtering. The full map shows the loaded area; doors and pipes change areas. 1:1 preserves pixels, while zooming out reduces them.
Rewind help detail: Hold the selected control to rewind at the original game speed. Sound can also run backwards. Memory is bounded and the save-state file format is unchanged.
Preview help detail: Ghost images are informative and do not simulate distant objects. Verified placements can appear at entry; learned pictures come only from your local game.
XR help detail: In AR, the outer background can be transparent. One grip moves an object; two grips resize it. The remote provides modes and settings. Physical headset testing remains outstanding.
